verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no automatic memory that the agent builds and recalls across sessions. Grok saves conversations to disk and lets you resume them, which continues a single session. AGENTS.md project rules are notes the user writes and Grok reads each session, not memory the agent builds itself. Both are adjacent features, not the capability in this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent build and recall memory automatically across sessions
